rapport_notes: Good rapport, personable, thorough with an easy-going customer.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "one more question aside from the pricing. What are you most worried about for this upcoming move?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised real concerns (schedule coordination, storage conditions, TV/sound system) but rep responded with only generic reassurance and pivoted straight to pricing — no follow-up questions.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "If you're planning to take a car load or staging the boxes... you save a lot of time... a lot of money" (self-prep hit); "Does that sound fair?" asked with a genuine response; hourly "you only pay for actual time" framing (pay-less concept) also hit.

top_strength: Successfully closed the booking with a clean, explicit ask ("Would you like us to help out with the move?") right after a well-personalized estimate anchor.
coaching_note: The agenda question surfaced real, specific concerns that got zero follow-up — a textbook case of the 'acknowledge and pivot' failure mode the rubric flags as dominant.
